title: Formalize approved V2 design documents
goal: Create registered normative V2 requirements, architecture, detailed design, decision, change package, and traceability documents whose canonical content matches accepted TASK-025 and TASK-027 proposals
out_of_scope: Semantic changes to accepted overall or detailed design
acceptance_criteria: Normative V2 requirements and overall design preserve the accepted proposal semantics and are registered consistently
Normative detailed design canonical body is byte-normalized equivalent to the accepted TASK-027 proposal body and records both accepted subject and content hashes
DEC-002, CR-002, and V2 traceability approve only the reviewed scope and explicitly gate development on BL-003 activation

release_controls.target_environment: local dev branch normative V2 design workspace
release_controls.execution_window: current V2 authority and BL-003 preparation stage
release_controls.rollback_plan: remove unaccepted normative V2 documents and registry rows while retaining accepted proposal evidence
release_controls.observation_metrics: canonical hash equivalence, registry metadata consistency, traceability completeness, reviewer findings, and Release governance results
release_controls.stop_conditions: canonical design drift, registry mismatch, unapproved scope expansion, or unresolved reviewer finding
